answer: Peer-audit dune bond: newcomers stake 70 credits and log dune work in a velvet book at a willow post. Each epoch a beacon draws auditors to re-check three entries; forgery burns the bond, half goes to the auditor. Audits bill 35 first, 35+5(k-1) for the k-th, so 1,000 fakes owe 2,532,500 plus 70,000 locked, pool 40,000. A rented-auditor ring fails: the draw is public, a book checked twice burns both. Truthful agents keep one log, spend 35 once.
